answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must post a slashable bond into a time-locked forge that unlocks only after three consecutive epochs of independently attested work. Peers countersign only answers they can audit; a cohort that rubber-stamps clones loses its own bond when later audits diverge. The old fable that extra names buy extra votes fails because voting and grading rights sit on an island reserved for bonded, time-seasoned identities whose attestations can be slashed.
